$description: Jump Bit design tokens. Source of truth for jumpbit-theme.css and jumpbit-theme.axaml. Brand colors are taken from the Brand Kit color palette; derived and functional colors are marked.

ink.role: darkest, text on light, page background (dark theme)

charcoal.role: primary brand color, logo background, app icon

white.role: logo on dark, page background (light theme)

gold.role: optional highlight accent; approximated from the gold-foil mockup, not in the official palette
